scope: Native actual-component resolution and bounded first sensitivity screen; no coefficient fitting, opponent calibration, runtime admission or deployment
mapping: all 54 authored requests / 540 cars, exact two passes; doctrine aliases retained, never counted as independent physical samples
full_gp_baselines: 18 unique typed requests, player only, reachable_wear_v1 and minimum_grip, exact two passes

screen.distance: 5 laps, first actual compound, no service; diagnostic, not a shortened official GP
screen.concentrated_rounding: floor(budget*fraction + 0.5); remaining discretionary points to chassis; immutable HQ offsets added afterwards
screen.diversified: authored allocation; plus 50/50 concentration transferred by 1 or 2 points from engine/chassis to cooling or aero; total discretionary spend fixed
screen.selection: one fastest successful five-lap sample per concentrated/diversified category and cohort, tie by case id; failures retained; no best-finish substitution
screen.confirmation: each selected setup at inherited full GP plan, paired reachable/minimum, exact two passes; short-screen winners are not claimed full-GP optima

fixed_controls: actual point budget and HQ offsets
balanced player V2 mode and driver noise identity
inherited 90C mounted/pit tire convention for eras I/II; no silently generalized modern blankets
source stints and official GP distance on full runs
metrics: installed engine/components and strict driver identity
setup ranking changes between boundary algorithms
reserved: all other seeds and ambient/road temperatures
full integer allocation space and fine continuous slider optima
independent fixed-field opponent fitting and full-season evaluation
non_acceptance: do not claim absence of engine/chassis exploit from a coarse sample
do not require nonzero spend on each axis
do not increase cooling response just to make zero cooling lose
do not change a rival or seed to improve player comparison
no errors silently classified as fuel exhaustion
native cost is not WASM/VPS/RSS evidence
